messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 72 omitted, sha256 b08d8c3a740eb978>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Receiving Party may independently develop information similar to Confidential Information.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: Entailment
confidence: 72
reason: Clause 8(c) excludes from the definition of Information anything independently acquired or developed by the receiving party or its Representatives without violating the NDA, which implies such independent development is permitted.
<quote check="exact">has been independently acquired or developed by the undersigned or any of its Representatives without violation of any obligation under this NDA</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: Entailment
confidence: 88
reason: Clause 8(c) excludes independently acquired or developed information from the definition of Information, so the Receiving Party may independently develop similar information.
<quote check="exact">(c) has been independently acquired or developed by the undersigned or any of its Representatives without violation of any obligation under this NDA</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Entailment
confidence: 88
reason: Information that the undersigned has independently developed is carved out of the NDA, which implies the receiving party may independently develop such information.
<quote check="exact">(c) has been independently acquired or developed by the undersigned or any of its Representatives without violation of any obligation under this NDA;</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label":"Entailment","confidence":85,"quotes":["(c) has been independently acquired or developed by the undersigned or any of its Representatives without violation of any obligation under this NDA"],"reason":"Clause 8(c) excludes independently developed information from the NDA's coverage, which clearly implies the receiving party may independently develop such information."}
